title: The US Commerce Department issues an interim rule to limit remote access to advanced AI chips and servers from select countries, such as Singapore and Malaysia (Magan Crane/Bloomberg)
summary: Magan Crane / Bloomberg: The US Commerce Department issues an interim rule to limit remote access to advanced AI chips and servers from select countries, such as Singapore and Malaysia — The US Commerce Department issued an interim rule to limit remote access to advanced AI chips and servers from certain countries …
